newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil soften in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil soften in thin trade.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures drifted lower on Tuesday in a slow start to a week shortened by the long U.K. holiday weekend, traders said.
June Brent stood at $17.92 a barrel at 1149 GMT, just five cents off Friday's close, while May gas oil was a dollar weaker at $164.50 a tonne.
"Nothing new out there," one broker said, adding that colder weather in London was having little impact on prices.
"There is very little paper in the pits, volumes are low and the market is relatively easy to move," the broker said.
Technical analysts said the market would find good support at $17.61 a barrel, the low point of last month's trading range.
Dealers said they were awaiting the release late on Tuesday of weekly inventory data from the U.S. to provide fresh direction.
